name: Wix
needs: an app or a higher plan

invoices.text: {{check}} Invoices built in; a credit note is not possible, says Wix's help centre

omnibus.text: Not possible automatically, says Wix's help centre; an app does it

withdrawal.text: The owner builds it from a form, says Wix's help centre; or an app

vat.text: Tax by location; OSS and IOSS through an app

bookings.text: {{check}} Built in: Wix Bookings and Wix Hotels

bundles.text: Through an app, for stock counted from each item

stores.text: {{check}} Many sites in one account, a Premium plan for each

preorders.text: {{check}} Built in, paid in full upfront

tiered.text: Not possible automatically, says Wix's help centre; an app does it

referral.text: {{check}} Built in, on Business plans or higher

email.text: {{check}} Built in; scheduling a campaign needs an upgraded email plan

ai.text: {{check}} Aria and other AI agents; some use AI credits

mobilepay.text: Not offered as a payment provider, says Wix's help centre

carriers.text: Through apps, such as one for Posten Bring

strengths.text: You want Wix's own booking and hotel tools in the same product as your shop
You sell on many channels from the store, from Amazon and eBay to TikTok and Instagram
You want AI agents beyond the dashboard, such as one that answers your phone
You run a shop with a till in the US, Canada or the UK, where Wix POS works
You want a wide set of shop tools from Wix itself, in over 35 languages

title: Kaizena Flow compared with Wix

seo.title: Kaizena Flow vs Wix: compared for EU shops
seo.description: How Kaizena Flow compares with Wix for EU shops: the EU's rules, more ways to sell, AI, and what needs an app, checked on Wix's own pages.

heroRest: The legal side of EU selling, more ways to sell and an AI that runs the shop come with Flow. Here is how it compares with Wix, line by line.

faq.q: Can I move my Wix shop to Flow?
faq.bold: Yes, and we do it for you.
faq.rest: As part of getting you started, we move your shop free of charge. You can also copy pages from your live site and check your old links yourself.

faq.q: Do I need apps to get what the Flow column shows?
faq.rest: Everything in the Flow column is part of Flow. Owning several stores starts on the Grow plan.
Your store's database and servers are in Dublin, Ireland.

faq.q: Is it safe to let the AI work on its own?
faq.bold: You decide how much it does.
faq.rest: Refunds, emails to your whole list, changes to your staff and your domain always wait for your yes, and every change it makes is in the activity log.
